results.name: Construction rubble
results.description:
A photoscan of a stone and construction rubble pile. Model (FBX) has around 80.000 vertices. Textures are in JPG format in 8K (diffuse and normal) and 4K (AO and roughness).

Related models are the [huge stone pile](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/huge-stone-pile-8dfdc5bb37254610ae1f82b283a7c8a1) and the [stone rubble pile](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/stone-rubble-pile-ef4c4fc19b8e4a33a40ccf1d9a11f224).

Have fun!

*P.S. You can download this and other models from my [profile](https://www.fab.com/sellers/Exploring%20Europe%20and%20Beyond) at the Fab Store.*
